lines: core-js, 21,587 B on the chunk-vendors page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
6 delivered files carry no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
1,701,570 B in 428 pieces of 206 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
208 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (122 packages, 1,260 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
